import collections,hashlib,json,pathlib,subprocess
folder=pathlib.Path("research/results/restriction_resistant_spread_20260911_03")
counts=collections.Counter();ranks=collections.Counter();summary=None
with (folder/"certificate-01.jsonl").open() as stream:
    for line in stream:
        item=json.loads(line);kind=item.get("record","header");counts[kind]+=1
        if kind=="dual_witness":ranks[item["image_rank"]]+=1
        if kind=="summary":summary=item
assert summary and summary["all_passed"] and counts["dual_witness"]==392
hashes={}
for name in ("research/tools/find_restriction_resistant_spread.cpp",str(folder/"certificate-01.jsonl")):
    digest=hashlib.sha256()
    with pathlib.Path(name).open("rb") as stream:
        for chunk in iter(lambda:stream.read(1048576),b""):digest.update(chunk)
    hashes[name]=digest.hexdigest()
report={"schema":1,"records":dict(counts),"image_rank_counts":dict(ranks),"output_bytes":(folder/"certificate-01.jsonl").stat().st_size,"summary":summary,"sha256":hashes,"notebook_dependency":{"commit":subprocess.check_output(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"],text=True).strip(),"anchors":["overlap-normalization","overlap-removable-spread"]}}
(folder/"summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+"\n")
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
